title: Vinyl Tubing | Whip Hose (900mm)
description:
This food grade vinyl tubing is perfect for any whip vape and comes standard on all 7th Floor vaporizers.
Vinyl tubing is more clear then silicone tubing and does not pick up as much dust. It also tends to kink less then silicone hose.
Included
1 x 900mm Length Of Vinyl Tubing
